The SE will be responsible for engineering, configuring, testing, and maintaining SAP S/4HANA and surrounding AP, AR, Treasury, Cash flow, In-house cash, and hedging solutions throughout the application lifecycle.

The role requires strong knowledge of business processes within SAP S/4 Payables, Receivables and Treasury overall, as well as other non-SAP Treasury and financial systems. This position defines and drives the strategy for putting the engineering elements in place to support Corteva’s vision for Treasury, Banking processes and in-general, all Financials flows with external partners and related IT systems in the medium to long term. It involves discovering, validating, and mapping relevant business functions through interviews, research, industry trends, and developments, and leveraging them for modeling, prototyping, simulating, and analyzing current and future states using SAP and non-SAP solutions for Treasury, AP & AR to provide robust, scalable solutions.

The SE must be able to bridge the IT and business domains and effectively communicate with other Solution Engineers, Business Process Experts, configurators, and Solution Architects within Corteva IT to develop a consistent end-to-end solution supporting financial flows within Corteva and with external partners. The SE will thoroughly understand the Corteva Agriscience business strategy and processes for Treasury, AP & AR to help define and execute the overall ERP Finance Product Roadmap.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • SAP Solution Engineer for S/4HANA global solution spanning multiple countries over North America, Europe, LATAM, and Asia-Pacific for Treasury, AP & AR.
  • Exhibits good command of more than one of the following areas in SAP Treasury: Cash Management, In-House Cash, Payments, Multi-Bank Connectivity, Trading Platform Integration, short- and long-term investments and debt instruments, credit risk and market data management, and loan management (FS-CML).
  • Understands business processes and non-SAP applications integration related to Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) processes.
  • Understands business processes related to financial instrument hedging, such as intercompany loans and derivatives (e.g., FX options and FX forwards) or commodities hedging.
  • Translates and maps business processes to enable design in SAP AP, AR, TRM, hedging, and surrounding applications. Helps identify end-to-end functional and non-functional system requirements, including integration with other non-SAP tools and systems surrounding the S/4 platform.
  • Has hands-on ability to independently prototype SAP solutions to meet end-to-end Treasury, AP and AR requirements, or define a work breakdown structure for a configuration and development team to develop a cohesive working solution.
  • Is able to engineer SAP AP, AR and TRM configuration and enhancements for a robust, scalable solution.
  • Researches current trends and best practices to advise business leads and IT configurators on the best solution approach for Corteva.
  • Has hands-on ability to write system design documents, including detailed design and technical design, update requirements traceability, and develop test scenarios and cases.
  • Envisions critical scenarios and points of failure in the end-to-end process and defines relevant test cases. Performs end-to-end functional and non-functional testing of the system to meet requirements, including unit testing, SIT, UAT, regression testing, and performance testing.
  • Can identify and define process and system dependencies while implementing new SAP functionality in the context of ongoing enterprise business and IT initiatives.
  • Can understand requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, provide estimates, and suggest process and technology improvements.
  • Works with Run & Maintain service providers to manages the periodic SAP and non-SAP upgrades through evaluation, regression testing, and deployment.
  • Provides guidance with SAP-Security role design.
  • Owns the performance aspect of end-to-end SAP Treasury, AP & AR service delivery in Production.
  • Preferably has experience with SWIFT integration services, ISO 20022, and non-SAP Supply Chain Finance solutions.
  • Preferred solution design experience demonstrating an understanding of various Treasury business process designs and SAP integration experience with SAP and third-party platforms such as Serrala, Taulia, SAP-CCP, SAP Digital Payments (EBPP), FIS, 360T, IT2, and Bloomberg.

Qualifications

Position Requirements

  • Prior domain or functional experience with Treasury and Finance functions in large companies.
  • Understands how derivatives work in SAP, using FX options or FX forwards as underlying instruments. Experience with commodities futures, margin payments, or options instruments would be useful.
  • Ability to research requirements and solutions, evaluate alternative approaches, and present a recommended solution in SAP or similar Treasury systems.
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure project environment with speed and agility.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality/accuracy of deliverables, preferring outcomes over outputs.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness and ability to work independently, and drive results with peers, stakeholders, and customers.
  • Acts honestly and professionally, with the ability to handle highly confidential and time-sensitive information.
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask under minimal supervision.
  • Decisive ability to recognize when to act and when to escalate.
  • Demonstrable accumulated knowledge of Treasury processes in a global environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with large vendor partners, suppliers, and third-party contractors preferred.

Experience and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Treasury, or a related field. CPA, CFA, or an equivalent advanced degree preferred.
  • The ideal candidate will have experience in the Oil & Gas, Utilities, or Financial Services industries implementing and supporting SAP Finance and Treasury.

Benefits – How We’ll Support You:

  • Numerous development opportunities offered to build your skills

jobs.title: Engagement Lead, Finance and Accounting
jobs.excerpt: About TQATQA is the Agentic AI Experts.  We turn Agentic AI into real-world advantage, transforming how enterprises operate, adapt, and outperform.
jobs.description:
About TQA

TQA is the Agentic AI Experts. We turn Agentic AI into real-world advantage, transforming how enterprises operate, adapt, and outperform. We deliver agentic and automation solutions that work in production rather than in a laboratory, built across Microsoft, UiPath, and ServiceNow, with the integration expertise to connect legacy, cloud, and new platforms. We stay with our clients from vision through to measurable value.

Better. Faster. Proven.

Our values guide how we work: Be Human, Every Day. Always Moving Forward. Future Focused. A Trusted Partner.

About the Role

We are hiring a senior finance and accounting leader to become the domain authority on a major agentic AI and automation program inside a global marketing services group. You will not run a ledger. You will sit alongside the client’s transformation and controllership leadership, find the finance processes where agents and automation create genuine P&L value, prove the case in numbers, and keep a validated pipeline ahead of a multi-country delivery team. This is a client advisory role first and a delivery role second.

Our client is a publicly traded, digital-first global marketing network: more than 50 agency partners, over 13,000 specialists, operations across 40 countries, and revenue of approximately $2.9 billion. That federated structure produces finance and accounting complexity at scale. Many legal entities and ledgers, high-volume intercompany activity, project and job-level accounting, pass-through and media billing, and a monthly close that spans multiple agencies, currencies, and jurisdictions.

TQA has delivered automation for this client for more than nine months. The program is now moving from opportunistic quick wins to a curated, value-led pipeline delivered through dedicated pods. The constraint is finance domain judgment at the top of the funnel. The client’s transformation leadership cannot be in every finance conversation, so opportunities go unqualified and skilled delivery capacity waits on work that has not been validated or standardized.

This role closes that gap. You become the finance and accounting voice inside the program: the person in the room when agency and shared services teams talk about how work actually gets done, the person who recognizes where an agent beats a rule-based robot, and the person who hands delivery a backlog that is quantified, standardized, and ready to build.

Key Responsibilities

Advise the client, proactively

  • Act as the trusted finance and accounting advisor to the client’s transformation, controllership, and shared services leadership. Bring a point of view rather than waiting for a brief.

  • Represent the automation and AI agenda in agency and functional meetings where the client’s transformation team cannot be present. Act as their proxy and their advocate.

  • Challenge process design before automating it. Recommend standardization, control improvement, or retirement so that the program automates a good process rather than an efficient bad one.

  • Build relationships across the agency network so that finance leaders bring opportunities to you directly.

Own the pipeline and the value case

  • Identify, qualify, size, and sequence candidate processes across record to report, order to cash, purchase to pay, close and consolidation, intercompany, and management reporting.

  • Quantify each candidate: current effort and cost, target state, expected benefit, control impact, and payback. Present it in language a CFO organization accepts.

  • Keep a validated backlog running ahead of delivery capacity so that architects, analysts, and developers are never waiting on undefined work.

  • Decide, with the client, what to automate now, what to standardize first, and where an agentic solution is the right answer rather than traditional automation.

Shape solutions and assure delivery

  • Partner with solution architects and business analysts to turn finance process knowledge into agentic and automation designs on UiPath, Microsoft, and ServiceNow.

  • Set acceptance criteria that finance and audit will sign off, covering segregation of duties, evidence retention, auditability, and control impact in a public company environment.

  • Chair value readouts with client leadership. Connect delivered work to measured financial outcome rather than activity completed.

  • Support hypercare, knowledge transfer, and handover so that benefits persist after go-live.

Grow the account and the practice

  • Identify and shape adjacent opportunities, for example internal audit and controls testing, HR operations, and managed service, and work with the account team to bring them forward.

  • Feed reusable finance patterns, benchmarks, and accelerators back into TQA’s industry solutions library.

  • Coach TQA and client colleagues on finance domain context so that the whole pod raises its own commercial judgment.

How we will measure success

In the first 90 days

  • Client transformation and finance leadership treat you as a trusted advisor and invite you into conversations by name.

  • A documented finance and accounting process landscape exists, with each process rated for automation and agentic potential.

  • A qualified, sized, and sequenced pipeline covers at least the next two delivery quarters.

Within 12 months

  • A live value ledger links delivered automation and agents to quantified financial benefit, accepted by the client finance organization.

  • Measurable improvement in close cycle time, manual effort, or control exceptions across the processes in scope.

  • Pipeline coverage stays consistently ahead of delivery capacity.

  • At least one adjacent workstream opens as a direct result of your advisory relationship.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Twelve or more years in finance and accounting, including significant time in controllership, financial operations, shared services, or finance transformation leadership. A qualified accountant background is strongly preferred, for example CPA, CMA, ACA, ACCA, or CIMA.

  • Deep, hands-on process knowledge across the finance lifecycle: month-end close and consolidation, intercompany, order to cash and collections, purchase to pay, expense and vendor management, and management reporting.

  • Demonstrated delivery of finance transformation using automation, AI, or agentic solutions, with benefits you can describe and defend in numbers.

  • A track record of client-facing or business partnering work at CFO, controller, and vice president level. You are comfortable being the most senior finance voice in the room.

  • Proven ability to build business cases and value models that finance leaders accept and finance teams can verify.

  • Experience inside a complex multi-entity, multi-currency environment, ideally with shared services or global business services exposure.

  • Based in the United States with the right to work in the United States, and willing to travel to client sites occasionally.

Nice to Have

  • Finance leadership inside a marketing, advertising, media, or professional services business. You understand job and project accounting, work in progress, billable utilization, pass-through and media billing, principal versus agent revenue treatment, and the economics of a federated agency network.

  • Public company reporting experience, including SOX 404 control design and testing and working alongside internal and external audit.

  • Practical familiarity with UiPath, Microsoft Power Platform and Azure AI, or ServiceNow. Enough to judge feasibility credibly without designing the solution yourself.

  • Applied understanding of agentic AI in a finance context: when an agent outperforms a rule-based robot, how to set guardrails, and where a human must stay in the loop for control reasons.

  • Consulting or professional services delivery experience, including scope discipline, commercial awareness, and account growth.

  • Exposure to the finance platform landscape common to agency groups, for example NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Workday Financials, Coupa, BlackLine, or agency systems such as Workamajig or Advantage.

What working at TQA looks like:

Headquartered in Texas, USA, we’re an international technology services and consultancy, partnering with enterprises across North America and Europe to deliver next-generation results through emerging technologies.

This is an exciting time to join us as we scale our global presence, innovate with automation, AI, and data, and empower businesses to transform their industries.
At our core, we believe in innovation, impact, and growth, both for our clients and our people. We offer an accelerated career path, giving you the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects, develop your expertise, and grow into leadership roles quickly. If you're looking for a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you can make a real impact, this is the place for you.

TQA is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome your application and believe in diversity of experience and opinion. Applications will be considered without regard to education, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation, and beliefs. We celebrate multiple approaches and points of view and believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our growth and success, so we are building a culture where difference is valued.

Nous recherchons un(e) Analyste d’affaires TI afin de contribuer à la préparation, au cadrage et à l’analyse de projets technologiques dans le secteur de la santé et des services sociaux.

La personne accompagnera les demandeurs dans la clarification de leurs besoins et participera activement à la préparation des dossiers d’opportunité (DO) et des dossiers d’affaires (DA). Elle assurera également la coordination entre les secteurs d’affaires, les équipes TI, les responsables de projets et les différentes instances de gouvernance.

Le rôle nécessite une excellente capacité d’analyse et de rédaction ainsi qu'une bonne compréhension des processus de préparation et d’autorisation de projets TI.   • Expérience dans la rédaction ou la préparation de dossiers d’opportunité (DO) et de dossiers d’affaires (DA).
  • Capacité à rédiger et réviser des documents de présentation et de justification de projets.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.excerpt: • Are you a talented Graphic Designer with a passion for creating visually compelling designs that capture attention and elevate brands?
jobs.description:
• Are you a talented Graphic Designer with a passion for creating visually compelling designs that capture attention and elevate brands?

  • Do you enjoy turning marketing briefs into compelling, on-brand creative assets, whether it's ad creatives, social media graphics, landing pages, website visuals, email banners, illustrations, or infographics?

  • Do you have experience working with SaaS, tech, or digital product companies and understand how great design can support both brand and business goals?

  • Do you love taking an existing brand identity and finding creative ways to make it stronger, more consistent, and more recognizable?

  • Are you joining us from somewhere in Europe?Great! While we work remotely from different locations, this role requires you to be based in Europe so you can easily collaborate with the rest of the team.

We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join us and help shape the visual identity of our three products:WP Rocket,Imagify, and RocketCDN. 🚀

Keep reading for more details! 📝

Become Our New Graphic Designer !

As our Graphic Designer, you'll bring our marketing campaigns to life through engaging, high-quality visuals across all touchpoints. From ad creatives and campaign banners to landing pages, website visuals, and social media assets,you'll help shape how our products look. You'll also contribute to evolving our brand identities, bringing fresh ideas while ensuring consistency across channels. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and be an integral part of our Marketing team.

This role is fully remote, but to keep collaboration smooth and our working hours nicely aligned, we’re looking for someone based in Europe.

You’ll be officially employed in your country of residence through our Employer of Record (EOR) partner, so you can enjoy the flexibility of remote work while being fully employed locally.

What You Will Be Doing

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Own the visual execution of campaigns - defining creative angles and developing full asset sets based on briefs from the marketing team

  • Design a wide variety of ad creatives and formats - display banners across standard sizes and paid social - enabling testing and iteration to improve performance

  • Design and adjust website visuals to support conversion and campaign goals

  • Create brand assets across channels - social media graphics, email banners, infographics, illustrations, ebooks, and print materials

  • Contribute ideas to help evolve and refine brand guidelines and visual identity over time

  • Stay informed on design trends, competitor work, and best practices to bring fresh creative ideas to the team

What Do You Need To Excel at This Job

  • Proven professional experience as a Graphic Designer within a SaaS, tech, software, or digital product environment

  • Proven experience designing display advertising and paid social ad creative — banner sets adapted across standard formats and sizes (300x250, 728x90, 160x600, etc.), including multiple variations for performance testing

  • Proven experience designing landing pages, website visuals, and other web assets built to convert

  • Comfortable designing across other marketing formats too — email, infographics, and organic social, with knowledge of platform-specific best practices

  • Experience working with and evolving an existing brand identity, with a strong sense of visual consistency

  • Ability to translate a campaign angle or brief into compelling, on-brand visual assets

  • Strong proficiency with Figma and relevant Adobe Creative Suite tools such as Photoshop and Illustrator

  • Currently based in Europe and able to work within European working hours — you'll be part of the core marketing team, collaborating daily on calls and Slack

  • Ability to collaborate closely with copywriters, marketers, and other stakeholders to translate briefs and feedback into strong visual execution

  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple design requests and deadlines simultaneously

Do you want to know other things we appreciate about our candidates?

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment

    You are a doer, adaptable, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly.

  • Previousremote job experience.
    Slack will be your virtual office, where all the life of the company takes place.

  • Think beyond "making things pretty"

    You understand that great marketing design has a purpose. Whether you're creating an ad, banner, landing page, or campaign visual, you think about the audience, the message, the brand, and the goal behind the design.

About us

Founded in 2014 in the beautiful Lyon, France, WP Media is an equal opportunity employer with a distributed team of +45 teammates living around the world.
WP Media is the French company behind successful WordPress plugins like WP Rocket and Imagify. WP Rocket is the premium caching plugin for WordPress used by +5,000,000 websites worldwide. Our plugin makes sites go at the speed of light in just a few clicks. Imagify is our free image optimization service, including a free WordPress plugin: we have already optimized more than 19,000,000,000 images! 😲

You will join our remote, global Marketing team and collaborate with talented teammates across multiple countries and time zones. We have flexible working hours & a remote work culture. We value clear communication and encourage everyone to participate actively. We are eager to find out which new country will be added to our distributed team map! 🌍

WP Media is part of group.One, a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting and digital marketing services.

group.oneis a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1 500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.


Do We Share the Same Values?

Mutual respect, collaboration, and inclusivity.

These are the fundamental values that support our life as a team.

Healthy balance between work and private life.

We encourage our employees to enjoy their family and hobbies with flexible working hours and minimum vacation policy. There are no time cards to stamp, only customers to make happy and friendly teammates to work with! We care about the work you do, not about the hours you sit at your desk.

We like to see each other in person whenever possible.

Every year, we organize a trip with the whole team and spend a week of coworking and fun activities together.

To give you an idea, so far we have traveled to Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Greece and Serbia.

We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.

We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here—what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.

We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.

Now that we've told you so much about us, it's your turn.

Let us know why you would like to become our Graphic Designer and why you think you are the person we are looking for.

We can’t wait to receive your application! 🌟

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Data Center Networking Engineer to support our office.

HPE Networking is seeking a highly skilled and customer-focusedTechnical Solutions Architect (TSA)to serve as a technical leader and trusted advisor to service providers, enterprise customers, and strategic partners.

The Technical Solutions Architect will provide deep technical expertise inWAN routing, network infrastructure architecture, optical transport, data center connectivity, and emerging networking technologies. This role will support sales engagements, solution development, customer workshops, proof-of-concepts, and technical enablement activities.

The ideal candidate combines strong networking fundamentals with hands-on architecture and design experience across WAN, enterprise edge, optical transport, data center interconnect, and network automation technologies. The TSA will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, Professional Services, and partner organizations to architect end-to-end solutions aligned with customer business and technical requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for HPE Networking routing and infrastructure solutions.
  • Design and validate scalable WAN, enterprise edge, and data center interconnect architectures.
  • Provide technical leadership during customer briefings, workshops, proof-of-concepts, and strategic design discussions.
  • Develop reference architectures, solution designs, deployment guidance, and networking best practices.
  • Partner with account teams to understand customer requirements and align technical solutions with business outcomes.
  • Support partner and field enablement through technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and training.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Sales to influence product direction and drive customer success.
  • Support competitive positioning and technical differentiation of HPE Networking solutions.
  • Support large-scale networking opportunities from initial discovery through technical validation and deployment planning.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.

Required Technical Expertise

WAN Routing & Network Infrastructure

  • Deep hands-on experience withJuniper MX, PTX, and ACXplatforms.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Service Provider WAN architectures
    • Enterprise WAN and edge routing
    • Carrier Ethernet services
    • Internet peering and transit designs
    • Network resiliency and high-availability architectures

Routing Protocols & Network Services

Expert-level knowledge of:

  • BGP
  • MPLS
  • IS-IS
  • OSPF
  • RSVP-TE and Segment Routing concepts
  • L2VPN and L3VPN services
  • EVPN services

Optical & Transport Technologies

General knowledge and experience supporting:

  • Data Center Interconnect (DCI)
  • DWDM optical transport networks
  • Metro and long-haul transport architectures
  • Layer 1 transport and wavelength services

Access Networking

Working knowledge of:

  • Passive Optical Networking (PON)
  • Fiber access architectures
  • Broadband access technologies
  • Enterprise access technologies

Network Automation & Programmability

  • Experience with network automation frameworks and operational tooling.
  • General knowledge of:
    • Python
    • REST APIs
    • NETCONF/YANG
    • Ansible
    • Git-based workflows
    • Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies
  • Experience automating network configuration, validation, and operational workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EVPN/VXLAN data center fabric architectures.
  • Understanding of modern data center networking and cloud connectivity models.
  • Experience with network telemetry, observability, and network assurance platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure networking requirements and high-performance data center architectures.
  • Knowledge of security integration technologies, network segmentation, and policy-based networking.
  • Experience working with service providers, telecommunications organizations, large enterprises, or strategic technology partners.

Professional Qualifications

  • 8+ yearsof experience in networking architecture, systems engineering, consulting, or related technical roles.
  • Proven ability to engage directly with customer architects, network engineering teams, technical decision-makers, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical discussions and influence architectural decisions.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, customer-facing environment.
  • Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures.

Success Profile

The successful candidate will be atechnically curious, customer-oriented architectwho can effectively bridge business objectives and networking technology. This individual will bring deep expertise in routing and transport networking, demonstrate strong architectural and problem-solving capabilities, and be comfortable engaging with audiences ranging from network engineers to executive stakeholders. The successful candidate will confidently guide customers through the design and adoption of modern, automated, resilient network infrastructures.

Preferred Certifications

Relevant industry certifications are preferred, including:

  • JNCIP-SP
  • JNCIE-SP
  • JNCIP-ENT
  • CCNP Service Provider
  • CCIE Service Provider
  • CCNP Enterprise
  • CCIE Enterprise
  • MEF Carrier Ethernet certifications

Equivalent technical experience and certifications may also be considered.

Opportunity

This role provides an opportunity to shape strategic networking initiatives across HPE Networking customers and partners while helping drive the adoption of next-generationrouting, automation, optical transport, data center, and enterprise networking solutions.

jobs.description:
We're Novakid School, the next-generation early English learning platform that allows kids around the world to learn English efficiently, through play and fully remote practice with native-speaking teachers.

Think cutting edge technology like AI-powered games and training apps that promote English speaking and comprehension based on the use of authentic content in English language. Think certified professionals with years and decades of expertise in children's psychology and learning methods.

“Our Vision is to change the way ESL children learn English by making it more engaging, elective, fun, and accessible. The ability to master the English language from an early age is critical to achieving a path of greater success and fulfillment, socially, emotionally, academically and professionally.” – Max Azarov, Founder

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead Producer to run the day-to-day of our video production team and own how work gets prioritized, resourced and delivered across a high volume of marketing, brand and ambassador content. You'll lead a team of Creative Producers, work closely with editors, designers and scriptwriters, and be the person stakeholders come to when priorities need to be called. You'll report to our Creative Director.

This is a hands-on role: you'll operate as one more producer on the team as much as its lead, not manage purely from above.

Key Responsibilities

  • Stay hands-on: carry your own slate of productions alongside the team rather than only directing from above

  • Collaborate directly and efficiently with the other department leads, traffic, video editors, motion graphic designers, graphic designers and copywriters, so work moves smoothly from concept to delivery

  • Own capacity planning with the traffic team across the production pipeline, and push back on stakeholders when volume or timelines exceed what the team can deliver at quality

  • Drive prioritization conversations with stakeholders so the team focuses on the highest-impact work instead of trying to run everything at once

  • Raise the bar on brief quality, working with requesters up front to reduce back-and-forth and rework during production

  • Build and roll out production process improvements for large campaigns, such as parallel alignment, storyboard one-pagers, and early producer involvement at script stage

  • Own relationships with the freelance production network (editors, sound, VO) and key recurring stakeholders, including localization and ambassador teams

  • Manage the projects at risk, unblock bottlenecks, and keep pipeline visibility for the Creative Director and Creative Services Lead

  • Think beyond the day-to-day: anticipate where the team or pipeline will break before it happens, not just react once it does

  • Stay calm under pressure and shield the team from stress rather than passing it downstream, especially when deadlines or stakeholders get demanding

Requirements

What you bring…

  • Proven experience leading a video or creative production team, in an agency, studio, or in-house marketing environment

  • Hands-on production background: comfortable reviewing cuts, giving direct feedback on edits and storyboards, and picking up a shoot or production task yourself when needed

  • Working knowledge of video production tools and workflow (e.g., Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve at a review level, shooting and post-production logistics)

  • Track record of managing a high-volume creative pipeline: prioritizing, resourcing and protecting quality under real capacity constraints

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable pushing back and setting expectations with non-production teams

  • Proficiency and love for project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Monday.com, Trello)

  • Comfortable working across international, remote and cross-timezone teams

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities

  • English fluency (any other language is a bonus!)

What Success Looks Like (first 6 months)

  • Team capacity is mapped, and stakeholders are working within an agreed prioritization framework instead of everything being "urgent"

  • Storyboard one-pagers and parallel alignment are standard practice for large campaigns

  • Brief quality has visibly improved, with less back-and-forth and rework during production

  • Ambassador and freelance relationships are fully transferred and running smoothly

  • The Creative Producer team is confident and unblocked, with fewer projects sitting at risk

We Offer

  • Make an impact: Improve the lives of children around the world.

  • Grow with us: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

  • Thrive in a collaborative culture: Join a diverse and supportive team that values creativity and innovation.

  • Flexible work environment: Enjoy the freedom to work remotely

Job Description

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Set the multi-year vision for our interoperability. Own where interoperability is headed at Devoted, and turn that vision into measurable gains in clinical quality, operational efficiency, and the reliability of the data we depend on.

  • Deliver Devoted's interoperability compliance. Define what strong compliance looks like across a complex, shifting regulatory landscape and make sure Devoted stays ahead of it. Today that headlines with the CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization Final Rule (CMS-0057-F) but the mandate is the broader picture and whatever comes next, not any single rule.

  • Build the organization behind data exchange. Lead and grow the data exchange operational teams within our tech org that make interoperability real — clinical data acquisition, integration operations, and telephony — into an organization that executes at scale.

  • Get a sprawling landscape moving in one direction. Interoperability touches Clinical, Operations, Engineering, Data, Legal, and Compliance; you'll create alignment across all of them and clear the systemic blockers that slow data exchange.

  • Shape a deliberate vendor strategy. Build and steward our most important vendor partnerships — a multi-million-dollar portfolio — into a coherent strategy that strengthens capabilities, reduces integration risk, and serves Devoted's long-term interests.

  • Advance Devoted's interests in the outside world. Shape the relationships — and, where possible, the policy — with provider and regulatory partners that determine what data we're able to exchange and on what terms.

  • Be the authority leadership relies on. Translate a fast-moving, complex interoperability landscape into clear decisions for senior leadership.

Required skills and experience:

  • You've led at scale: 10+ years of relevant experience, including a track record of leading other leaders. You've built and scaled multi-function organizations and have recruited, coached, and mentored talent while setting a positive, high-accountability culture.

  • You know interoperability cold: A genuine command of the healthcare data exchange landscape — standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7, C-CDA), the regulatory environment (e.g., CMS Interoperability rules, ASTP/ONC, TEFCA, information blocking), health information exchange, and EHR and clinical/claims/pharmacy data integration.

  • You know how to deliver on regulation and compliance: You've hit major milestones that satisfy both regulatory requirements and business outcomes — ideally on FHIR/API-based initiatives such as the CMS interoperability rules — and you understand what it takes to succeed, coordinating technical and operational work across many teams to get there.

  • You've aligned the room: You've repeatedly brought many stakeholder groups to agreement on a single plan — listening, synthesizing competing input, and communicating a decision back to teams, leadership, and eventually an entire company.

  • You've been at the negotiating table: You've owned and negotiated multi-million-dollar vendor relationships, and you can read a vendor landscape and form a defensible point of view.

  • You've represented the org externally: You've been the credible voice for an organization's position with external partners — providers, regulators, industry forums.

  • You've owned the roadmap and the details: You've built multi-year strategic roadmaps and driven them to measurable business and operational outcomes without losing the thread on execution.

  • You bringa data-driven mindset, a super proactive "get it done" attitude with the skills to back it up, and the mental agility to stay sharp, re-prioritize quickly, and thrive amid the uncertainty, fast pace, and flexibility inherent in a startup.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Provider, Payor or EHR experience: Working experience in a care delivery or health insurance environment, partnering across clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to drive patient outcomes and member experience.

  • Data exchange from the inside: Experience at an EHR, health information network, or clinical data intermediary/platform — a background that brings source-level fluency in how clinical data actually moves and a connectivity-first, build-fast mindset to the problem.

  • Value-based care: Understanding of payment incentives and frameworks for delivering value from a risk-bearing provider perspective.

  • Regulatory engagement: Direct experience engaging with regulatory partners and shaping or responding to interoperability policy.

  • Financial acumen: Strong financial modeling and budgeting skills, and experience owning a domain budget.

Desired Qualities:

  • You genuinely nerd out on interoperability. You understand the problems deeply, you have a real perspective on where the industry is heading, and you enjoy keeping up with the regulations and the standards.

  • You want to make healthcare better through better data exchange. You see interoperability not as plumbing, but as one of the highest-leverage ways to improve care for older Americans.

  • You can toggle between the details and the strategy. You know the specifics cold and you hold the overall vision — and you move fluidly between the two.

Salary range: $257,500 - $290,000 annually

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

jobs.excerpt: About the role: We run a distributed, camera-based video monitoring and AI alerting platform.
jobs.description:
About the role:

We run a distributed, camera-based video monitoring and AI alerting platform. The system spans the full spectrum of modern and legacy infrastructure: an AWS-hosted fleet of Java microservices and workers, a GPU-backed computer-vision inference pipeline, a real-time streaming and presence layer, and thousands of on-premise edge "media boxes" deployed in the field that ingest camera feeds, serve HLS video, and stream events back to the cloud.

This is a reliability-first role. Your primary job is to keep a large, mixed operational estate healthy at scale: meaningful service objectives, trustworthy alerting, sound capacity, tested disaster recovery, and fast, calm incident response. Delivery pipelines matter, but here they exist in service of reliability, not the other way around. We are not hiring a pipeline-and-self-service DevOps engineer who treats operations as a side concern. We are hiring an SRE who owns uptime and operational quality, and who can write the software to make that uptime measurable and automatic.

If you think in SLOs, error budgets, and blameless postmortems, and you are happiest when a noisy, fragile system becomes quiet and predictable on your watch, this is your role.

What you'll keep reliableYou will own the operational health of all of the following:
  • Computer-vision / AI models: frame-based inference services running on GPU EC2 (g4dn-class, AWS Deep Learning AMIs), fed by camera frames from S3 and a Kafka (Amazon MSK) event bus, with Redis (ElastiCache) for state. Outputs flow through an alerts pipeline (OutgoingInferenceMessage to SNS/IoT to notification workers).
  • Python services: the AI/alerts inference tier and supporting tooling.
  • Legacy Java services: ~140 Java 8 services and libraries (REST APIs, SQS/SNS workers, Lambda functions) running on Jetty 9.4, deployed to Elastic Beanstalk, ECS, and Lambda.
  • Edge appliances ("media boxes"): Ubuntu 22.04 / Docker Compose appliances managed remotely over AWS IoT Core secure tunnelling, with Cloudflare tunnels for egress. Includes an active CentOS 7 to containerized-stack migration effort.
  • Data and messaging backbone: PostgreSQL (RDS) across many schemas, TimescaleDB for analytics, Redis, DynamoDB, Amazon MSK (Kafka), SQS/SNS, and Kinesis.

What you'll do Reliability and operations (the core of the role)
  • Own service objectives. Define SLIs and SLOs for the services that matter, manage error budgets, and use them to drive prioritization and change-rate decisions. Make reliability a measured number, not a feeling.
  • Make observability trustworthy. Own alert quality end-to-end: high signal-to-noise, alarms that reliably catch the incidents they are meant to catch, and the discipline to turn off a misleading alarm until it is fixed properly. Build the dashboards and the custom metrics, exporters, and instrumentation (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry) needed to see the system clearly.
  • Lead incident response. Run incidents calmly, drive mean-time-to-recovery down, and produce blameless postmortems with action items that actually get closed. Improve and own the on-call rotation and its health.
  • Plan capacity and performance. Forecast and right-size compute (especially GPU), Kafka/MSK throughput and partitioning, RDS/TimescaleDB load, and Redis. Catch saturation before customers do.
  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery. Backups, replication, failover, and recovery for RDS, MSK, Redis, and the edge fleet. Define RPO/RTO and prove them with regular, tested game days, not assumptions.
  • Keep the edge fleet healthy. Remote diagnosis and recovery over AWS IoT, container auto-update over systemd timers, and the ongoing CentOS 7 migration to the containerized media stack (Ubuntu 22.04).
  • Engineer away toil. Write real software (Python, Golang, Bash) to automate operational work, self-heal common failures, and make reliability repeatable instead of heroic.
  • Govern production change safely. Enforce collaborative, reviewed change management; protect the system from risky, unilateral changes (topology, instance-count, scaling, and config).

Delivery and platform (in support of reliability)
  • Keep CI/CD healthy and safe: CircleCI with Bazel/Gradle builds, OIDC-based AWS auth, container builds to ECR, and EB/ECS/Lambda deploys, tuned so that releases are safe, observable, and reversible.
  • Maintain Terraform for the AWS estate (compute, networking, IAM, databases, messaging, monitoring), following our module-based conventions and S3-backed state.
  • Harden security and compliance: IAM least-privilege, Secrets Manager/KMS, TLS and certificate management (including IoT device certificates), CloudTrail, and AWS Config.


Requirements


  • AWS certification is mandatory. A current AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional is strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years in Site Reliability Engineering or production operations at scale. We do not expect mastery of every area below on day one. We expect real depth in several and the ability to ramp quickly on the rest.
  • Demonstrated SLO/error-budget practice. You have defined SLIs and SLOs, run against an error budget, and used it to make real decisions.
  • Strong production observability skills. Deep with metrics, logs, alarming, and dashboards (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, and/or Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog), and able to build the instrumentation when it does not exist.
  • Proven incident command. You have led incidents, owned an on-call rotation, and written postmortems that changed how a system behaved.
  • Capacity planning and performance experience across compute, databases, and a messaging or streaming system (Kafka/MSK ideal).
  • Disaster recovery ownership: backups, replication, failover, and tested RPO/RTO.
  • Software engineering ability for automation. Comfortable writing Python, Golang, and Bash to build reliability tooling, not just configure off-the-shelf tools.
  • Expert with Terraform (or equivalent IaC) and strong Linux administration (shell plus Linux GNU utils), comfortable from cloud to bare-metal/edge.
  • Database operations experience with PostgreSQL (time-series a plus).
  • A reliability mindset: you instrument before you guess, and you write the runbook.
Nice to have
  • Operating GPU workloads and serving computer-vision or ML models in production (CUDA, Deep Learning AMIs, inference scaling).
  • Apache MSK / Kafka and streaming-data operations (Kinesis, Kinesis Video Streams).
  • AWS IoT Core at scale: device provisioning, certificates, secure tunnelling.
  • Managing a fleet of edge / on-premise devices (golden images, remote update, systemd).
  • Operating and modernizing legacy systems (Java 8, Jetty, CentOS).
  • Chaos engineering / game-day practice, and capacity modeling.
  • Familiarity with Bazel in a monorepo; Cloudflare, Cognito/Auth0, API Gateway.

How we work, and what we expect from this hire:

These principles reflect lessons we take seriously. The right candidate already operates this way:
  • Observability must be trustworthy. Alarms that cry wolf are worse than no alarms. You own alert quality end-to-end: high signal-to-noise, alarms that reliably catch the incidents they are meant to catch, and the judgment to turn off a misleading alarm until it is fixed properly rather than leave a noisy one firing. We have felt the cost of unreliable alerting and want someone who closes that gap and keeps it closed.
  • Change management is collaborative, never unilateral. Any infrastructure change that affects a service is made together with the engineer who owns and understands that service. Scaling, instance-count, topology, and config changes are reviewed with that owner before they ship. Single-instance vs. multi-instance assumptions, in particular, are never changed on a guess.
  • Follow-through over activity. We measure outcomes, not effort or hours. When something is asked for, we expect it driven to a correct, durable resolution on a reasonable timeline, not left half-solved for months. Find what is actually needed, focus on it, and finish it.
  • Prefer the right fix to a quick patch. Solve the root cause. Do not paper over it and move on.

  • Enterprise security architectures, including OAuth2 connectivity, principal propagation, role/authorization concepts, and secure extension strategies

  • Modern debugging and distributed tracing, working across ABAP, SAP BTP services, and integration touchpoints

  • Solid debugging capabilities: ABAP debugger, dumps (ST22), performance analysis (SAT, SQL trace)
  • Familiarity with the S/4HANA data model, including key simplification topics
  • Experience with transport management and the SAP development lifecycle
  • Understanding of authorization concepts and security basics

Ability to follow clean-core principles and SAP’s extension guidelines

We are seeking a detail-oriented Depo Transcript Attorney to join our Workers' Compensation practice. Preferred

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

What You'll Own

  • Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.

  • Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.

  • Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.

  • Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.

  • Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.

  • Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.

  • Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

What We're Looking For

Technical

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.

  • Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

Product & AI

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.

  • Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

Mindset

  • Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.

  • Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.

  • Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

What you'll do

As Fire Alarm Engineer at Giga, you will provide technical design leadership and expertise for fire alarm systems, detection systems, smoke control systems, and life safety systems across our AI data center facilities. You'll work on multiple concurrent projects, ensuring technical excellence, design quality, and code compliance while mentoring junior staff and collaborating closely with project teams, clients, and authorities having jurisdiction. This is a hands-on specialist role for someone who wants real technical ownership and thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments.

Where you'll work

This role is based in one of our offices (Houston, TX / Long Beach, CA / San Francisco, CA / Reno, NV) or fully remote. We work in person because the best engineering happens when smart people are in the same room. Some travel to active project sites and client meetings should be expected.

That said, we will make exceptions for truly exceptional talent if you live outside one of our hubs. If you're the right person for this role, we'll have a conversation about what works.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical design leadership for fire alarm systems, detection systems, smoke control systems, and life safety systems on data center and mission-critical facility projects
  • Design fire alarm and detection systems using manufacturers' equipment and best practices appropriate for data center facilities
  • Design detection and monitoring for lithium-ion battery energy storage and UPS battery systems, including off-gas detection, hydrogen monitoring, and thermal runaway response sequences
  • Develop sequences of operation, equipment schedules, riser diagrams, and device layouts, and prepare and maintain fire alarm specifications
  • Develop smoke control and management strategies aligned with facility operations and life safety requirements
  • Perform quality control review of fire alarm and life safety systems drawings, ensuring technical accuracy, code compliance, and alignment with design intent
  • Provide design guidance and markup comments on other engineers' and designers' submittals, explaining best practices based on real-world data center experience
  • Ensure design compliance with IBC, IFC, NFPA 1, NFPA 101 Life Safety Code, NFPA 72 Fire Alarm and Signaling Code, NFPA 75, NFPA 76, NFPA 92, NFPA 2001, NFPA 2010, NFPA 13, NFPA 855, and NFPA 70 (NEC), and with FM Global Property Loss Prevention Data Sheets as Owner design criteria
  • Coordinate fire alarm and life safety system designs with mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, and fire protection disciplines
  • Interface with clients, AHJs, and fire alarm contractors to convey and defend design intent, obtain approvals, and resolve technical issues
  • Support field activities including site observation, acceptance testing with AHJs, and resolution of construction-phase issues
  • Mentor junior engineers and drafters on fire alarm system design, code requirements, and best practices
  • Participate in design reviews and quality assurance/quality control efforts across multiple concurrent projects

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience designing fire alarm systems
  • NICET Fire Alarm Systems (FAS) Level III or IV certification
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field
  • Experience working on Data Center projects
  • Extensive knowledge and design experience with fire alarm systems and related manufacturers' equipment, including VESDA aspirating systems, VEWFD spot smoke detectors, and addressable panels
  • Extensive knowledge and design experience with releasing service and suppression interlocks, including preaction and double-interlock preaction systems, clean agent systems, and generator and battery enclosure interfaces
  • Extensive knowledge and design experience with lithium-ion battery hazards, including off-gas detection, hydrogen monitoring, and thermal runaway response sequences
  • Proficiency in IBC, IFC, NFPA 1, NFPA 101 Life Safety Code, NFPA 72 Fire Alarm and Signaling Code, NFPA 75, NFPA 76, NFPA 92, NFPA 2001, NFPA 2010, NFPA 13 and NFPA 855
  • Knowledge and application of FM Global Property Loss Prevention Data Sheets as Owner design criteria
  • Knowledge and application of NFPA 70 (NEC), including Article 760, and electrical design requirements for fire alarm and life safety systems
  • Extensive design experience in data center fire alarm and life safety systems
  • Field experience with fire alarm system installation, testing, and commissioning, including acceptance testing with AHJs
  • Proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD to produce complete construction documents — riser diagrams, device layouts, equipment schedules, and sequences of operation — including battery, voltage drop, and NAC and SLC circuit calculations
  • Proven ability to self-check work, verifying cross-references between sheets, specifications, and sequences of operation, and confirming model numbers against manufacturers' data sheets
  • Able to work with the Engineer of Record on design direction, incorporate review comments, and coordinate with drafters and other design disciplines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain design decisions to the Engineer of Record, clients, and AHJs
  • Able to carry multiple concurrent design assignments and deliver on schedule without sacrificing quality
  • Able to work with minimal day-to-day oversight, make decisions with available information, and move fast in a high-velocity environment

Bonus points

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification
  • Experience estimating and scheduling mid-to-large-scale projects
  • Experience in fire protection and plumbing design is a plus.
  • Familiarity with hyperscale, colocation, and AI-focused data center facility requirements
  • Texas project experience and familiarity with local AHJ processes

We value people who take ownership, raise risks early, communicate directly, and follow through. Incomplete information is part of the job. Make the best decision you can, document it, and adjust as the facts change. Move quickly on reversible decisions and take more care when security, safety, financial, employee, or customer risk is involved.

  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Commuter benefits, where applicable
  • Opportunities to collaborate in person at periodic team and company on-sites

jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor

**A note before you read further**

The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

About Human Agency

We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

The Opportunity

Most designers have a lane. Brand people make things look right. Product people make things work right. Systems people make things scale right. You refuse to pick, and that refusal is exactly what we're after. We work with clients ranging from early-stage ventures to established organizations, all navigating a pivotal moment in how AI is reshaping their products and brands. They need design that holds up at the identity level and at the component level, and they need it from someone who can move fast while also adhering to critical details no one else would think to notice.

This role exists because our clients' design needs don't stop at a logo or a Figma file. They need visual systems that a developer can build from, a brand team can extend, and an AI tool can interpret. You'll be the person who owns that full arc, from first-pass brand exploration through the token naming convention that makes the system actually usable, and you'll do it across multiple client engagements at once.

You've also already reckoned with what AI means for how design gets made. You're not experimenting with it cautiously; you've rebuilt your workflow around it because the old one stopped making sense. That's the standard here, and it's one we're going to keep raising.

What You'll Own

  • Brand Identity & Visual Direction — Lead brand identity work for clients from concept through final delivery, making and defending decisions about typography, color, motion, and voice with the confidence of someone who's done it before and knows why it works.
  • Design Systems Architecture — Build design systems from the ground up (components, documentation, governance), not extend someone else's library. Your systems should be usable by engineers, legible to AI tooling, and maintainable by teams that outlast the engagement.
  • Web & Product Design — Own end-to-end design for web and product experiences, from information architecture and interaction patterns through final specs, with enough craft in the details that clients are delighted on the first round.
  • AI-Augmented Workflow — Use AI tools actively across exploration, iteration, and systemization to move faster and produce more considered work, and share what you're learning with the team so we all get better.
  • Client Collaboration — Present and defend design decisions directly to client stakeholders, translating the reasoning behind visual and systems choices into terms that land with non-designers without dumbing anything down.
  • Cross-Functional Handoff — Work closely with engineers, strategists, and AI practitioners to ensure design outputs are implementable, appropriately scoped, and set the people coming after you up to succeed.

Who You Are

Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years of design experience with meaningful work on both brand identity and digital product, not one with a footnote of the other.
  • A portfolio that includes at least one design system you built from scratch, starting from a brand identity rather than inheriting an existing component library.
  • Demonstrable fluency in Figma, including variables, auto layout, and component architecture at a level that would impress an engineer who's seen bad handoffs before.
  • A real track record of shipping brand identities and web experiences for clients or products people actually use, not just speculative or academic work.
  • Current, working knowledge of AI tools applied to design workflows (generative image tools, LLM-assisted copy exploration, prototyping acceleration, or comparable) used in a way that's changed how you actually work, not just how you talk about working.
  • Strong enough grasp of front-end constraints (HTML, CSS, design tokens, component-based development) to design systems that developers want to build from.
  • Experience working in a consultancy, agency, or multi-client environment where you've had to context-switch across industries and brand voices without losing rigor.

Mindset & Traits

  • You'd rather build the thing than write the deck about why the thing should be built.
  • You're not precious about methodology or tools, but you care about outcomes, and you update your approach when something stops working.
  • You can hold a high aesthetic bar and a high functional bar at the same time without treating them as competing priorities.
  • You take feedback without flinching and give it without softening it into uselessness.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity at the start of a project and disciplined enough to create clarity by the end of it. You want to be somewhere that rewards moving fast and building well, and you're put off by places that side-eye either one.

Logistics

  • Remote-first position open to candidates based in the United States or Canada.
  • This one's Eastern time zone; we need real-time overlap with the team.
  • Contract-to-hire preferred.
  • Some travel may be required for client engagements or team gatherings.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.
