jobs.excerpt: Role ContextAppsilon has historically grown on the strength of inbound: our brand, open-source credibility, and content have brought qualified leads to us.
jobs.description:
Role Context

Appsilon has historically grown on the strength of inbound: our brand, open-source credibility, and content have brought qualified leads to us. That engine is still important — and we want to keep making it stronger.

At the same time, Appsilon is entering the next stage of growth. Inbound alone will not get us to where we want to go. We want Marketing to become an equal partner to Sales in building a qualified pipeline, including through targeted outbound campaigns.

As Head of Marketing, you will lead this shift. You will own the marketing strategy and team, while working closely with the CEO and Head of Sales to make Marketing a measurable contributor to revenue growth.

The north star for the role is SQL value: the qualified pipeline value Marketing contributes, rather than lead volume or top-of-funnel activity in isolation.

You will also play a key role in shaping how Appsilon is positioned in the market. We are a specialist consultancy in clinical trial analytics — not a general-purpose software provider or staffing company. Our marketing needs to communicate deep domain expertise to pharma and life sciences decision-makers while continuing to resonate with the technology and open-source community that has helped build our reputation.

This is a leadership and strategic role that reports directly to the CEO. You will own the marketing function end-to-end - including strategy, budget, team structure, and external partners - and lead a team of currently two marketing specialists.

Role Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute a marketing strategy aligned with Appsilon's revenue and growth targets.

  • Define Marketing's role across the full funnel, balancing our established inbound engine with new outbound-supporting initiatives.

  • Translate company and Board-level priorities into clear marketing goals, initiatives, and measurable outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve growth, customer acquisition, and marketing efficiency, and turn them into actionable plans.

Demand Generation: Inbound & Outbound

  • Continue to strengthen Appsilon's inbound engine across content, SEO/SEM, events, social, and other relevant channels.

  • Partner closely with Sales to design and run targeted campaigns that convert outbound interest into qualified opportunities, including ABM, targeted content, sales enablement, and co-designed outreach campaigns.

  • Develop a content strategy aligned with customer segments and commercial goals, covering formats such as case studies, blog posts, videos, and sales-facing materials.

  • Build a strong feedback loop with Sales so that marketing and sales activity is continuously improved based on what is converting, what customers need, and where opportunities are being lost.

Brand & Positioning

  • Build and protect Appsilon's position as a high-end, specialist consultancy in clinical trial analytics.

  • Develop messaging that demonstrates credibility and relevance to pharma and life sciences decision-makers.

  • At the same time, maintain a strong connection with the broader technology and open-source community that amplifies Appsilon's reputation and reach.

  • Adapt messaging, content, and channels to different audiences without diluting the overall Appsilon brand.

Data, Experimentation & AI

  • Define KPIs and benchmarks across marketing channels, with SQL value as the north star.

  • Run marketing through clear hypotheses: define what an initiative should achieve, test it, measure the outcome, and act on what you learn.

  • Review performance regularly and reallocate budget quickly when campaigns or channels fail to meet agreed targets.

  • Use data to understand not only what worked, but why - and turn those insights into better decisions and new experiments.

  • Use AI extensively to automate reporting and data synthesis, analyze sales and market signals, and generate insights that inform campaigns, messaging, and positioning.

  • Identify opportunities to automate processes and introduce tools that improve the speed and quality of marketing decisions.

Team Leadership & Commercial Partnership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing, distributed marketing team.

  • Own the development of the Marketing function, including team structure, hiring priorities, and the use of external partners and contractors.

  • Support individual growth, motivation, and well-being while maintaining a strong focus on team results.

  • Work closely with the CEO, Head of Sales, and Technology Unit Leaders to align marketing activities with broader business priorities.

  • Partner with Sales as a shared owner of pipeline generation, rather than treating Sales as an internal customer.

  • Own the marketing budget and resource allocation, making investment decisions based on expected business impact and SQL value contribution.

Your Metrics

The primary measure of success is:

  • SQL value - the qualified pipeline value Marketing contributes across inbound and outbound.

  • New logos from Life Science Drug Development projects.

Supporting metrics include:

  • SQL volume

  • MQL-to-SQL conversion rate

  • Inbound traffic and engagement

  • CAC

  • Content and campaign performance

  • Event participation and asset downloads

  • Other agreed leading indicators of the future pipeline

We’re looking for someone with:

  • 6+ years of marketing leadership experience in B2B IT, ideally in an international company.

  • A proven track record of running full-funnel campaigns from strategy and concept through execution across both inbound demand generation and outbound-supporting, sales-aligned campaigns.

  • Experience owning or jointly owning a pipeline or revenue-related KPI with Sales, rather than focusing exclusively on brand and awareness metrics.

  • Strong strategic thinking combined with the ability to move quickly from strategy to execution and iteration.

  • A data-driven approach and strong comfort with numbers, analytics, and performance measurement. You can explain not only what worked, but why something missed the target and what you would do next.

  • A strong understanding of B2B marketing channels and concepts, including content, SEO/SEM, paid campaigns, partnerships, and ABM.

  • Experience working in a remote-first, international environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal English.

  • Strong communication skills: you listen well, retain context, communicate clearly, and approach others with openness, patience, and emotional intelligence.

  • A proactive, ambitious mindset and a strong bias toward continuous improvement.

  • A good understanding of the B2B IT world and how technology creates business value.

  • Hands-on experience using AI in day-to-day marketing work, particularly for reporting, synthesis, market intelligence, and turning sales and market signals into marketing input.

  • A strong sense of ownership for team and business results, with the ability to motivate people through clear goals, visible progress, and measurable wins.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience in marketing a niche or highly specialized product or service, particularly in B2B technology or professional services.

  • Experience in an environment where marketing and Sales jointly own or influence pipeline generation.

  • An interest in open source, pharma, or clinical research.

We offer

  • A high-impact leadership role with direct ownership of marketing strategy and its contribution to company growth and qualified pipeline.

  • The opportunity to shape how Marketing and Sales work together, with shared goals and real influence on revenue growth.

  • Autonomy to shape the Marketing function - including strategy, budget allocation, team structure, and agency/vendor partnerships.

  • Fully remote work, flexible working hours, with core responsibilities in CET.

  • Performance-based bonus of up to 2 monthly salaries per year, tied to agreed targets.

  • Time and budget for continuous professional development, including conferences, mentoring, and workshops.

  • Modern equipment (MacBook or ThinkPad with Linux) and tools that support effective work.

  • A remote-first, trust-based culture built on ownership, accountability, and partnership.

What can you expect during the recruitment process?

  1. General interview with the People Team – a conversation about your experience, motivation, and expectations.

  2. Interview with the CEO and selected team members – a deeper discussion about your marketing experience, business thinking, and approach to the role.

  3. Recruitment Task (case study) – a practical case designed to understand how you approach a real business challenge. We expect this to take no more than 3 hours.

  4. Case study presentation & discussion – you will present your approach and discuss your thinking with the hiring team, followed by questions and discussion (around 1 hour).

  5. Team & culture interview – a 1.5-hour conversation with members of the team you'll work with, focused on collaboration, communication, and how you approach working together.

  6. Final alignment conversation – if needed, a final conversation with the CEO to address any remaining questions and ensure a strong match on both sides.

  7. Offer

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Life at BHG Financial

At BHG Financial, we work hard and aren’t afraid to take risks. You will provide leadership, modern-state strategic and technical marketing expertise, and deep healthcare industry insight. Responsibilities include understanding market needs, aligning product positioning with customer demands, and using market intelligence to influence both product development and marketing. The global role will be responsible for all lead generation efforts, modernizing, deploying and managing our technical marketing stack leveraging AI capabilities, marketing and thought-leadership content development, general sales-enablement efforts, and web site management.

You will collaborate with the executive team and business unit leaders on data driven commercialization strategies, including segmentation and territory design, pricing and packaging, and competitive intelligence, while ensuring Nox maintains a unified global brand voice. You will also gain insight into customer behavior and improve funnel conversions using behavioral science principles. Ownership of Nox’s value proposition is key, involving continuous evaluation and refinement to align with market needs and differentiate from competitors.

Saving the World! Help Wanted…

Budderfly is a fast-growth, private equity-backed energy management outsourcing company that is committed to reducing global carbon emissions for small to medium sized enterprises. We are the premier sustainability partner for businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurant chains, assisted living facilities, retail franchises, and more. We are an energetic and dedicated team working together to make a positive impact on the environment while providing an excellent customer experience. We are growing quickly and looking to add talented people who are passionate about making the world a better place!

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Project Manager to join our Battery Storage deployment team.

In this role, you will oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of behind-the-meter battery storage projects, including site readiness, equipment delivery and staging, installation, utility interconnection, permitting, and commissioning. You will work closely with subcontractors, electrical contractors, and utility partners to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards.

This position demands strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proven experience managing electrical field installations. The Project Manager may also support additional energy-saving efforts, such as solar, EV charging, or lighting and HVAC conservation projects, contributing to broader sustainability and resource management goals.

Why this Role is Important:
This role is essential for deploying battery energy storage that reduces peak demand charges, improves site resiliency, and enables participation in utility demand response and grid services programs. By overseeing safe, code-compliant BESS installations and commissioning, the Project Manager directly contributes to both environmental impact and operational savings.

Key Responsibilities:

Oversee contractor-led installations and commissioning of battery energy storage systems and associated electrical infrastructure, ensuring all work meets company standards for quality and safety, stays on schedule, and is delivered within budget across complex, multisite projects nationwide.

  • Work closely with contractors to forecast and schedule battery storage installations, ensuring timely execution and alignment with project timelines, equipment lead times, and resource availability.
  • Manage permitting, utility interconnection applications, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) inspections, tracking approvals and resolving jurisdictional requirements that impact project schedules.
  • Coordinate site readiness activities, including electrical service evaluation, load and metering data review, structural and clearance requirements, and equipment placement.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with contractors, fostering effective communication, collaboration, and accountability throughout project execution.
  • Monitor contractor performance by evaluating adherence to project schedules, budget constraints, safety requirements, and quality expectations, and provide feedback and guidance as necessary.
  • Oversee commissioning, startup, and acceptance testing, verifying that system controls, communications, and performance meet design intent prior to project closeout.
  • Enforce electrical safety and code compliance requirements, including NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 70E, and NFPA 855, ensuring contractors follow approved lockout/tagout and energized work practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, incentives, procurement, fulfillment, and install support, to ensure seamless project delivery.
  • Identify and mitigate risks and obstacles that may impact project timelines or quality, implementing corrective actions as needed.
  • Proactively communicate project status, updates, and potential delays to internal stakeholders and customers, maintaining strong relationships and delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Collaborate with Fulfillment and Procurement to manage the Bill of Materials (BOM) for each battery storage project, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of batteries, inverters, switchgear, and balance-of-system materials to contractors.
  • Coordinate with Fulfillment/Procurement to resolve any issues related to material availability, quality, or delivery, ensuring timely resolutions to maintain project momentum.
  • Maintain accurate inventory and asset records, tracking serialized equipment and all project-related materials, ensuring proper documentation of usage, storage, and replenishment to prevent shortages and avoid project delays.
  • Ensure that all project documentation is accurate, complete, and up to date, including project plans, progress reports, change orders, commissioning records, warranty registrations, and closeout documentation.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • A minimum of 4 years in project management, preferably in battery energy storage, solar, or electrical construction.
  • 1-2 years in energy/construction management ideally working with utility or city municipalities.
  • Experience managing subcontractors overseeing electrical, energy storage, or construction projects.
  • Working knowledge of battery energy storage systems, inverters, switchgear, metering, and utility interconnection processes.
  • Familiarity with applicable codes and standards, including the NEC, NFPA 855, and UL 9540, and with local permitting and inspection processes, preferred.
  • Facilities management/building engineer experience preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to travel to project sites as needed, with flexible hours to align with contractor and field crew schedules.
Compensation

Compensation is based on factors including level of experience, skillset, qualifications, and location.

  • Competitive pay

jobs.description:
Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

What You'll Do:

Answer questions with data

  • Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
  • Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
  • Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
  • Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them

Design and measure experiments

  • Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
  • Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
  • Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process

Bridge marketing and engineering

  • Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on
  • Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
  • QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
  • Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them

Automate and improve how we work

  • Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it
  • Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
  • Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them

What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies

  • Basic working knowledge of SQL.
  • Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code.
  • More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
  • Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
  • A strong bias for action

Educational & Professional Experience

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
  • Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
  • Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
  • Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

Position Description:

At ServiceTrade, you’ll build technology that matters — for your career, your team, and the thousands of commercial contractors who rely on our platform every day. We’re on a mission to partner with commercial trades to deliver technology that enhances technician productivity, improves customer experiences, and drives scalable growth.

We’re looking for a Corporate Account Manager who’s excited to make an impact. In this role, you will be responsible for retention and the expansion of customers’ investment in ServiceTrade apps and services. You are responsible for a portfolio of high-end customers in a geographic region. You will ensure that your customers understand the ServiceTrade customer journey, increase their business revenue through the investment and adoption of ServiceTrade’s apps and services, and negotiate and secure ongoing renewals with us. You will conduct business reviews, establish growth plans, demonstrate solutions, and ensure that issues are addressed by appropriate departments within ServiceTrade. We provide a team environment and work in conjunction with other ServiceTrade departments, such as Sales, Customer Success, Customer Support, Professional Services, Sales Operations, Product Management, and Marketing.

Why ServiceTrade:

You’ll belong here from the start.

We bring together kind, curious people with diverse perspectives and trust them with meaningful work. You’ll have ownership, clarity, and support to solve real problems, make a visible impact for our customers, and continue growing as your role evolves.

On the Revenue team, you’ll have the opportunity to conduct high-stake deals, navigate intricate and complex sales cycles, and leave an indelible mark on the landscape of our industry.

About you:

You are an active listener and ask insightful questions to understand your customers and their businesses. You know how to research and engage with your accounts at multiple levels to understand how our solutions fit into their overall plan for success. You understand the value of having a methodology for understanding business levers and processes, you can make recommendations, take ownership of challenges, and deliver value to your clients. You are polished and professional in your interactions internally and externally.

The successful candidate will be intellectually curious and resourceful, an enthusiastic collaborator, an agile and consultative business partner, and a customer-first thinker. This role is ideal for someone who thrives under pressure, embraces challenges, and consistently achieves outstanding results through commitment, execution, and finesse.

Key Responsibilities and Activities:

Maximize Retention and Minimize Churn

  • Engage key customer executives and users as the primary business point of contact with ServiceTrade customers
  • Conduct regular business review conversations remotely and on-site with customers to drive usage, adoption, and value realization within the ServiceTrade application
  • Identify Risk Accounts and address potential issues that may prevent customers from maximizing their adoption of ServiceTrade
  • Assist customers by escalating issues and needs to Customer Success, Customer Support and Professional Services teams

Increase Customer Investment in ServiceTrade applications and services

  • Create opportunities for clients to increase their investment in ServiceTrade through business reviews and product demonstrations
  • Create quotes, manage sales cycle and close sales orders for expansion and upsell opportunities within ServiceTrade customer base
  • Negotiate and close complex renewal contracts that build in growth and additional investment where possible
  • Exceed quota by effectively managing pipeline of expansion and upsell opportunities in Salesforce.com in addition to maintaining accurate forecasts of ARR increases

Account Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Develop and maintain account plans that align customer goals with ServiceTrade's solutions
  • Manage internal action plans across Sales, Customer Success, Customer Support, Professional Services, Sales Operations, Product Management, and Marketing to achieve customer goals

Training and Administration

  • Maintain high level of understanding of the Commercial Service Contractor industry and ServiceTrade products and services through certification and ongoing training
  • Master key skills and competencies that are required to perform this role at the highest level
  • Prioritize activity through effective time management and scheduling of customer reviews and communications
  • Maintain accurate customer account records and effectively document activity in Salesforce.com and other sales tools

Knowledge and Skills

  • B.A. or B.S. degree with 4+ years of Account Management or equivalent B2B sales experience
  • Expertise in SaaS solutions
  • Demonstrated history of success in obtaining and hitting sales/revenue quotas
  • Possess corporate level presentation/reporting abilities
  • Relationship development skills at all levels within a client organization
  • Highly organized and ability to prioritize activity and work in a fast paced, team environment
  • Selling experience and understanding of sales process required
  • Professional oral, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Proficiency with Google Apps, Salesforce.com, Gong.io, Zoom or Google Meet preferred
  • Some travel experience and ability preferred (<15%)

A few things you’ll want to know:

What does ServiceTrade do?

ServiceTrade is a best-in-class field service management platform that helps commercial fire protection and mechanical service contractors build efficient and growing businesses. With more than a decade of innovation and 1500 customers, ServiceTrade streamlines operations from the field to the office, boosts technician productivity, and enhances the end-customer experience.

Ok, so why should I care about that?

Our customers do essential work — often behind the scenes — and our software helps them do it better. They’re smart, hardworking people, and we take pride in helping them grow their businesses, earn more revenue, employ more skilled workers, and deliver greater value to their own customers. When you work at ServiceTrade, your impact extends beyond our walls, supporting communities and markets you might never have thought about — and making work that truly matters every day.

What kind of working environment do you have?

We’re a growing business focused on building with intention and operating with purpose. You’ll have meaningful responsibility and the trust to do your best work from the start. We encourage calculated risks and bold experimentation, while providing opportunities to learn, grow, and turn today’s lessons into tomorrow’s breakthroughs—all in service of big ambitions and real customer impact.

Learn more about our culture and values on our About Us page.

What kind of benefits do you offer?

  • Medical through Cigna, PPO and HDHP options, including a Health Savings Account with company contributions Dental and Vision through Unum
  • Flexible Spending Account and Dependant Care Account
  • Company-paid Life insurance, STD and LTD
  • Voluntary benefits including Supplemental Life Insurance, Critical Illness, Accident and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with up to 3% employer match and NO vesting period
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • 10 company holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Paid Time Off for Volunteering
  • Employee Reimbursement Program to use for well-being, technology and/or professional development

Want to know more?

Go ahead and apply! Let’s get to know each other.

ServiceTrade is not registered to hire in all 50 states. You must reside in one of the states listed to be considered.

(AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA)

ServiceTrade provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for an Accounts Payable Specialist II to join our team! The Accounts Payable Specialist II processes and reviews accounts payable transactions and applies accounting principles to verify accuracy and completeness. The role analyzes invoices, reviews and verifies account coding to ensure accuracy, compares invoices to contract terms to verify accuracy and compliance, and supports reconciliation activities to ensure accurate disbursement of funds and integrity of financial records.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Process and review accounts payable transactions to ensure completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Analyze invoices and supporting documentation to verify alignment with contractual and policy requirements.
  • Assign and validate account codes based on organizational chart of accounts.
  • Identify discrepancies in payables data and coordinate resolution with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Maintain detailed records of payment activity, documentation, and transaction history.
  • Reviews invoices against contract requirements to ensure accurate billing and supporting documentation.

Agentic Threat Modeling & Continuous Validation

Shifting Security Left into the SDLC

AI & Emerging Threat Defense

This is a foundational opportunity to define what Application Security looks like in an AI-native enterprise—securing not just code, but decisions, agents, and intelligence at scale.

Job title: Senior Full Stack Web/Mobile Application Engineer

Department: Development

The Role:

As our agency grows, we are taking on more and more web and mobile application projects for our clients. Our application frontends are typically built on Next.js and React, with React Native when a project calls for a mobile app. The REST and GraphQL APIs that drive them and integrate with other systems usually run on Node.js or Laravel. You don't need to be an expert in all of these, but we're looking for well-rounded developers who have a working knowledge across these stacks, can learn on their feet, and start contributing quickly to deliver for our clients.

We expect engineers at this level to do their work with AI agents. We use a spec-driven process to plan and specify features with AI before anyone starts implementing them, and our senior engineers help set the AI development standards that the rest of the team follows. We're looking for people who have already built this into how they work and have opinions about what makes it go well.

As a client services agency, we're always expanding into new technologies and platforms to meet our clients needs, so we are looking for developers who love keeping up-to-date on the newest advancements in the field and can figure out when to start applying those advancements to client work.

You'll be working on several projects at any time; typically one or two large application projects and a few smaller projects to keep things fresh.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Building new applications, websites, and features with a variety of tools, languages, and technologies, including Next.js, React, React Native, Node.js, and Laravel.
  • Planning and implementing work with AI agents, using our spec-driven process to settle the approach before the code gets written, and helping set the AI development standards that more junior engineers follow.
  • Acting as the Technical Lead (TL) on your projects. You'll partner with the project manager to lead the project’s development team, and you'll share ownership of the project's financial success alongside its technical success, including managing scope against the budget and raising problems early enough to do something about them.

jobs.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
  • Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.
  • High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.
  • Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.
  • Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the Role

Flex is looking for a curious, detail-oriented analyst to join our Financial Crime team. In this role,
you will be reviewing transaction monitoring alerts, conducting KYC due diligence, and helping keep
our platform and our customers safe against money laundering, fraud, and other illicit activity.
This is a great opportunity for someone early in their compliance career who wants to build deep
expertise in a fast-paced fintech environment and grow into broader program responsibilities over
time.

What You'll Do

Transaction Monitoring

• Review and disposition transaction monitoring alerts, applying BSA/AML typologies to
distinguish suspicious activity from false positives
• Draft clear, well-supported case narratives and escalate higher-risk activity for supervisory
review
• Contribute to UAR/SAR filing support under the direction of senior team members
KYC & Customer Due Diligence
• Conduct KYC reviews for new and existing customers, verifying identity documents and
assessing risk profiles
• Identify customers that warrant enhanced due diligence (EDD) and flag for escalation
• Maintain accurate, complete records in our case management system

Program Support

• Assist with periodic quality assurance and file reviews, including for our bank partner
program
• Help identify patterns or process gaps that could improve detection coverage or review
efficiency
• Participate in team training and stay current on evolving AML typologies and regulatory
guidance

What We're Looking For

Required
• 1–2 years of experience in BSA/AML compliance, fraud operations, or a related financial
crimes role (internship or co-op experience considered)
• Working knowledge of KYC/CDD requirements and BSA obligations
• Strong written communication — you can explain why something is or isn't suspicious in
plain language
• High attention to detail and comfort working through ambiguous or incomplete information
• Ability to manage a queue and prioritize effectively
• Embody a growth mindset and bring a self-driven mentality to your work

Nice to Have
• Experience with a transaction monitoring platform (e.g., Sardine, Unit21, Actimize, or similar)
• Exposure to fintech, payments, or BaaS program compliance
• CAMS or other AML certification in progress or completed

Why Flex

At Flex, you'll work on real compliance problems that matter — not just processing tickets in a queue. You'll collaborate directly with program leadership, have visibility into how our financial crime program is built, and grow your skills faster than you would in a large-institution role. We invest in our team's development and support professional certifications.

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.
Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.
Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.
True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.
Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.
High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.
Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.
Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

About Eleanor Health

At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. We work to fulfill this goal by building and growing the first addiction and mental health services provider designed to deliver a longitudinal, whole-person, value-based model of care for each community member. Our team is ambitious and committed to this unique opportunity, and understands the importance of attracting strong and experienced talent to make our vision for Eleanor Health a reality every day, and for every recovery journey we are entrusted to be a part of.

About the Role

Eleanor Health is seeking a compassionate and dedicated Certified Medical Assistant (CMA). The CMA will play a crucial role in supporting our mission to provide comprehensive and compassionate care to individuals recovering from substance use disorders. The ideal candidate will possess strong clinical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a deep commitment to improving patient outcomes. Our care model is delivered both virtually and in-clinic. This is a virtual role with the potential to become hybrid depending on location. This position is Full Time.

What You'll Do

  • Member Care:
    • Conduct initial member intake and assessments, including social history, medical history, current medications, and overall member needs.
    • Assist with the coordination of member care plans, ensuring adherence to prescribed treatments and protocols.
    • Support members through the intake process, monitoring for withdrawal symptoms and providing appropriate interventions.
    • Provide direct member care, which may include administering medications, injections, and other clinical tasks as directed by healthcare providers.
    • Help cultivate a distinctive and engaging workplace culture grounded in mission focused care, proactive initiative, ethical conduct, and strong team collaboration.
  • Clinical Support:
    • Prepare and maintain examination and treatment areas, ensuring a clean, safe, and organized environment.
    • Manage and document member information in electronic health records (EHR) systems accurately and efficiently.
    • Assist with obtaining prior authorizations and pre-certifications as appropriate.
    • Serve as the first point of contact for medication-related questions, ensuring timely and appropriate escalation to the medical teams.
    • Perform routine in-clinic laboratory tests, including urine drug screens, ensuring accurate documentation and reporting of results.
  • Administrative Duties:
    • Schedule and coordinate member appointments, follow-ups, and referrals.
    • Provide member education and resources on health maintenance, medication management, and substance use disorder recovery.
    • Assists with front office tasks, including telephone reception, scheduling, check-in and time-of-service collections.
    • Maintain inventory of medical supplies and equipment, ensuring proper stock levels and functionality.
  • Team Collaboration:
    • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings to discuss member progress, challenges, and care strategies.
    • Communicate effectively with members, families, and team members, demonstrating empathy and cultural sensitivity.
    • Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the development of best practices in substance use disorder treatment.

Qualifications

  • Education & Certification:
    • High school diploma or equivalent required.
    • Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant or LPN program.
    • Current certification as a Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) from a recognized certifying body (e.g., AAMA, AMT, NCCT)
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a clinical setting, preferably in a substance use disorder treatment facility or behavioral health environment.
    • Experience with EHR systems and medical documentation.
  • Skills & Abilities:
    • Strong clinical skills, including medication administration, and basic laboratory procedures.
    • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a focus on patient-centered care.
    • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast paced, team-oriented environment.
    • Compassionate approach to patient care with a strong understanding of the complexities of substance use disorders.
    • Comfortable with ambiguity and taking on a variety of tasks, as needed

Compensation & Benefits

The total target compensation range for this position is $20-22 per hour. This depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

Eleanor Health offers a generous benefits package to full-time employees, which includes:

  • Generous Paid Time Off (prorated for new employees) - unplug, relax, and recharge!
    • 12 Vacation days
    • 12 Wellness (Sick) days
    • 3 Floating holidays
    • 9 Company-observed holidays
    • Jury Duty, Voting Leave, and other forms of paid time off may be available
  • Eleanor-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage -We are a health first company, and we strive to make our plans affordable and accessible.
  • 401(k) plan with 3% match - We are excited to be able to support the long-term financial well-being of our team in a way that reinforces Eleanor’s commitment to equity.
  • Short-term disability - We understand that things happen, we want you to feel comfortable to take time to get better.
  • Long Term Disability - Picks up where Short Term Disability leaves off (employee paid).
  • Life Insurance - Both Eleanor and employee-paid options are available.
  • Family Medical Leave -Eleanor Health’s Paid Family & Medical Leave (“PFML”) is designed to provide flexibility and financial peace of mind for approved family and medical reasons such as the birth, adoption, or fostering of a child, and for serious health conditions that you or a family member/significant other might be facing.

jobs.description:
Role: Automation Program Manager/ QA Consultant- Automation

Duration: Long Term

Location: Remote

About the Role

Facility is integrating a Warehouse Control System with ERP for inventory management. We are seeking an experienced Automation Test Program Manager / QA Consultant to own end-to-end test strategy and execution across this automation initiative, driving the program toward a full go-live by end of December.

This is a hands-on leadership role — not a pure documentation function. The consultant will need to build the test plan, actively run the test cycle day-to-day, coordinate across engineering, operations, and IT teams, and translate testing status into clear, executive-ready reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Strategy & Planning: Develop a high-level, end-to-end test plan covering the full device flow — from automation hardware/conveyance triggers, through (WCS layer) logic, to ERP (receiving, put-away etc.).
  • Test Cycle Management: Own and manage the test cycle schedule, including test case development, environment/data readiness, defect triage, regression cycles, and UAT sign-off criteria.
  • Cross-Team Coordination: Work directly with automation/hardware teams, WCS product/engineering teams, ERP IT teams, and warehouse operations to align on test scope, dependencies, and readiness gates.
  • Integration & Interface Testing: Ensure test coverage of system integration points — automation-to-WCS signals/events and WCS-to-ERP transactional integration (e.g., inventory updates,serial number tracking).
  • Defect & Risk Management: Establish a defect tracking and triage process; identify, escalate, and drive resolution of blocking issues; maintain a go-live risk register.
  • Executive Reporting: Produce regular, concise status reporting for executive leadership — test progress, defect burn-down, go-live readiness, and risk callouts — suitable for steering committee/leadership review.
  • Go-Live Readiness: Define and track exit criteria/entrance criteria for go-live; support cutover planning and hypercare test validation post-launch.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in test program management, QA leadership, or systems integration testing, ideally within supply chain, warehouse automation, or logistics environments.
  • Demonstrated experience testing systems that span WCS/WMS layers and ERP inventory systems
  • Experience with warehouse automation go-lives — conveyance systems, sortation, robotics, or similar physical automation integrated with software control layers.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end test methodology: test strategy, test case design, UAT, regression, defect management, and readiness/exit criteria.
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, operations, vendors, IT) without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executive/leadership audiences.
  • Comfortable working on-site in a warehouse/DCC operational environment in Nashville.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with sortation/guidance systems (e.g., put-to-light/sort-to-light) or automated transport (e.g., AMRs/robotics).

Deliverables

  • High-level end-to-end test plan and test strategy document
  • Test cycle schedule and tracking dashboard
  • Defect/risk log with escalation cadence
  • Go-live readiness assessment and exit-criteria checklist
  • Weekly/bi-weekly executive status reporting through go-live

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

HealthMark Group is a leading provider of health IT solutions for healthcare providers across the country. Purview is a software-driven healthcare company committed to increasing health equity and improving patient outcomes by enabling secure, flexible, and scalable access to medical images and records. Its suite of products, including Horos, Purview Image, and Expert View, empowers physicians, radiologists, veterinarians, and other providers around the world to view, share, and analyze medical imaging data. Acquired by HealthMark Group, Purview now operates as a dedicated business unit, maintaining its mission-driven culture and product focus while benefiting from HealthMark’s scale and operational infrastructure.

We are seeking an organized, proactive Operations Associate to lead customer-facing implementation, deployment, and cross-functional initiatives for Purview. This role will focus on project planning, coordination, communication, risk management, and successful delivery across customers, internal teams, partners, and third-party vendors.

Role Overview

As a Operations Associate at Purview, you will own projects from initial discovery through planning, execution, launch, and closeout. You will establish clear scope and success criteria, maintain schedules and documentation, coordinate stakeholders, identify and manage risks, and keep teams aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

The Operations Associate will serve as a central point of coordination for customers and internal teams, including Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Sales. Success in this role requires strong organization, sound judgment, clear communication, customer focus, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving healthcare technology environment.

  • Use a formal project-management lifecycle—initiating, planning, executing, monitoring and controlling, and closing—to manage customer implementation, deployment, internal improvement, and cross-functional initiatives from start to finish.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, customers, internal Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, and third-party vendors to ensure alignment, integration success, action-item ownership, and on-time delivery.

  • Handle multiple concurrent projects by prioritizing, re-scheduling, balancing deliverables, refining templates and processes, documenting lessons learned, and adapting to changing customer requirements, business needs, or technical challenges.

Required / Core

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for customers, leaders, internal teams, and cross-functional partners.

  • Customer-focused, accountable, and collaborative approach to problem solving, issue resolution, and decision making.

Preferred

  • Experience with imaging, EMR, veterinary practice, or archive platforms such as Epic, Ambra, ezyVet, PACS, VNAs, or similar systems.

What Makes This Role Unique

You’ll work at the intersection of data, operations, and AI-enabled workflows

jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical builds the open-source software that runs the world’s clouds, devices and AI, and we hold our managers to a high standard. Our Talent Development team exists to make leaders and managers at Canonical genuinely excellent. We define what great management looks like here, and we put that standard into the hands of managers and leaders across the company.

The Organisational Development Associate is where our most driven early-career people begin. From day one you work with real teams and take on real change, coached hard by senior practitioners on a fast path toward running this work yourself. This is not a support or back-office role, and it is not generalist HR. We hire for potential, drive and coachability over a polished CV, and we back the people we hire to move fast.

Applying to this role will enter you into our People Track for consideration across roles in the function.

Location: These are remote based positions, available across EMEA and the Americas.

The role entails

  • Being embedded inside a real team: see how it works day to day, and surface what is and isn't working.
  • Running the diagnostics on a team's health and management effectiveness (engagement, 360, direct feedback), and turning the evidence into a clear, honest read.
  • Owning an improvement end to end: a concrete change to how a team works that you design, drive and land, with a senior practitioner alongside you.
  • Supporting managers in delivering effective 360 performance feedback to individuals and helping them turn it into two or three real commitments they follow through on.
  • Helping build the playbook: the standards, tools and shared language the whole function runs on. You are building the system others use, not producing filler.
  • Learning coaching and organisational development directly from senior practitioners, on a fast, visible path to running this work yourself.

What we are looking for in you

  • A track record of leading and organising early. You have run things, built things, won people over and made change happen, in a startup, a student society, the military, a team, anywhere. People around you already see you as a driver.
  • A deliberate pull toward developing people and organisations. You chose this field on purpose, with a real grounding in organisational or industrial psychology, behavioural science or a comparable basis. It is not a fallback.
  • Drive and eagerness to learn. You have your own ideas and the confidence to challenge, and you are hungry to be coached and to grow fast.
  • The presence to sit across from experienced people and talk about change with confidence.
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • Up to around two years of experience since graduating.
  • Business level written and spoken English.
  • Organised, accurate, confident, authentic, results-oriented, and enthusiastic.
  • Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.

In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:

  • Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
  • Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
  • Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
  • Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Any exposure to people, organisational, coaching or consulting work, through study, an internship or a first job.
  • A genuine interest in the craft of management and organisations, not just the subject matter.
  • Comfort working with data.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.

  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations & Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
jobs.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the Role

Syndio's marketing organization runs a high volume of concurrent, cross-functional initiatives: product launches, category campaigns, executive events, partner co-marketing, and strategic brand work, spanning Brand, Content, PMM, Revenue Marketing, and PR. This role exists to make sure that volume of work actually lands: on time, with clear ownership, and with visible progress against goals.

This is a hybrid role by design. Half the job is marketing operations: the systems, processes, and infrastructure that let the team execute efficiently (tooling administration, vendor operations, reporting, workflow design). The other half is program/project management: building project plans, running cross-functional standups, tracking deliverables to completion, and defining and measuring what success looks like for major initiatives. The person in this role is the connective tissue across the marketing org, the one who can tell you, at any point, what's in flight, who owns it, what's at risk, and whether it's working.

This is not a role for someone who wants to specialize narrowly in either ops administration or project coordination alone. We need a systems thinker who can operate in both modes and knows when each is called for.

What You'll Do

Portfolio & Project Management

  • Build and maintain project plans for major cross-functional marketing initiatives (product launches, campaigns, executive events, partner programs), with clear milestones, owners, and dependencies
  • Run recurring cross-functional standups and check-ins for shared projects, keeping stakeholders aligned and unblocked
  • Track deliverables and status in a system of record, maintaining a single source of truth for what's in flight across the org
  • Identify risks and bottlenecks early, and escalate or resolve them before they threaten a deadline
  • Partner with initiative owners (Brand, Content, PMM, Revenue Marketing, PR) to define success criteria up front, and build the tracking to measure against it after launch
  • Maintain a rolling view of marketing's full project portfolio for the SVP of Marketing and leadership team: what's active, what's coming, where the capacity constraints are

Marketing Operations

  • Own and administer core marketing systems and tools (project management platforms, marketing automation/CRM touchpoints as applicable, reporting dashboards)
  • Manage marketing budget tracking, vendor onboarding/contracts administration, and purchase order workflows
  • Design and maintain repeatable operating processes: campaign intake, creative request workflows, approval chains, content calendars
  • Build and maintain reporting on marketing performance and operational health for leadership and board-level updates
  • Serve as the process owner for how work enters the marketing org and how it's prioritized across competing demands

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with Brand/Creative, Content/Communications, Revenue Marketing/Events, and Product Marketing leads to understand upcoming needs and build realistic plans around them
  • Partner with Sales, Product, and Executive teams on marketing's role in cross-org initiatives (e.g., major launches, executive events, partner announcements)
  • Serve as a dotted line to revenue operations to stay up to date on technology, workflows, and shared success outcomes
  • Act as a trusted operator for the SVP of Marketing, someone who can take a half-formed initiative and turn it into a structured, trackable plan without needing heavy hand-holding

What You'll Bring

  • 4-7 years of experience in marketing operations, marketing project/program management, or a hybrid of both, ideally in B2B SaaS or a similarly fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ownership of project management tooling (Monday.com, Notion, Asana, or similar) at a team or org-wide level, not just individual task tracking
  • Experience running cross-functional standups or working sessions with stakeholders across brand, content, product marketing, and revenue marketing
  • Comfort building project plans from scratch for ambiguous, multi-stakeholder initiatives, and driving them to completion without direct authority over the people involved
  • Operational fluency: budget tracking, vendor management, process design, and reporting infrastructure
  • A systems-thinking mindset: someone who sees how the pieces of a marketing org connect and builds processes that scale, rather than one-off fixes
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate status and risk clearly for both individual contributors and executive stakeholders
  • Bias toward structure and follow-through: this person creates order in ambiguity rather than waiting for it to be handed to them

Nice to have

  • PMP, Agile/Scrum, or similar project management certification
  • Experience supporting executive-level events or major public launches (product, brand, or category launches)
  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce) from an operations/admin standpoint

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $127,500-145,000 USD per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to (includes up to 25 days PTO in UK) plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.
  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 📍Remote within the US (East Coast preferred)

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

  • Full visibility established: every major active marketing initiative has an owner, a plan, and a tracked status in Monday/Notion
  • Recurring cross-functional standups are running and stakeholders trust them as the source of truth for status
  • At least one major initiative (e.g., a product launch or executive event) is run end-to-end through this role's project management process, with documented success criteria defined before launch and measured after
  • Core marketing ops processes (intake, approvals, budget tracking) are documented and running with minimal SVP intervention
  • The SVP of Marketing has a reliable, standing view of portfolio health without having to personally chase status updates

The interview overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Marketing Operations & Program Manager position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  1. Recruiter Screen (25 min) — chat with our Talent team and learn more about Syndio and the role.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 min)
  3. Marketing Conversation (30 min)
  4. Crossfunctional Team Interviews (3 x 30 min)

At Syndio, we're building a diverse team that values candor, curiosity, and community. If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. We don't expect anyone to have all the answers, as long as you're willing to learn and grow with us.

Syndio is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are building an inclusive and collaborative workplace as we grow, and we welcome team members regardless of gender/identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, physical disability and age.
